- (Airway smooth muscle)

#### Intro:

+-------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Respiratory musculature | - All muscle relevant to ventilation is skeletal and striated except airway smooth muscle |
|                         | - Primary ventilatory muscles mostly Type 1 = oxidative, fatigue-resistant                |
|                         |   - Diaphragm 55% in adult, 20% neonate                                                   |
|                         |   - Intercostals 65% adult, 45% neonate                                                   |
+-------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Control of breathing    | - Activity co-ordinated in medullary resp centre                                          |
|                         |   - Dorsal inspiratory group                                                              |
|                         |   - Ventral expiratory group                                                              |
|                         |   - Pre-Botzinger pacemaker cells                                                         |
|                         | - Normally involuntary. Can be controlled voluntarily by cortex.                          |
+-------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Inspiration:

+--------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Aims                     | - Overall: ↓intrapleural pressure → ↑transpulmonary pressure                   |
|                          |   - ↑ AP diameter of chest (↑APD)                                              |
|                          |   - ↑ transverse diameter of chest (↑TD)                                       |
|                          |   - ↑ chest wall elevation (↑CWE)                                              |
|                          |   - Maintain airway patency (↑AP)                                              |
+--------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Diaphragm’s contribution | - Upright adult: 50%                                                           |
|                          | - Supine adult: 66%                                                            |
|                          | - Neonate: ↑ (cartilaginous ribs = ineffective intercostals                    |
|                          | - Pregnant: ↑ (upward displacement = increased excursion)                      |
+--------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Primary muscles          | - Diaphragm:                                                                   |
|                          |   - Dome shaped muscle between thorax and abdomen                              |
|                          |   - Attachments: L and R crura to vertebral bodies, lower 6 ribs, xiphisternum |
|                          |   - Central tendon fused to fibrous pericardium                                |
|                          |   - Innervated by phrenic nerve C3-4-5                                         |
|                          |   - Descends 1-2cm in quiet inspiration                                        |
|                          |   - Descends 10cm in max inspiration                                           |
|                          +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                          | - External intercostals:                                                       |
|                          |   - ↑APD, ↑TD by “bucket handle” activity                                      |
|                          |   - From rib above space to rib below                                          |
|                          |   - Fibres in front pocket direction                                           |
|                          +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                          | - Scalenes:                                                                    |
|                          |   - ↑CWE, counteract inward movement of upper ribs by diaphragm                |
|                          |   - From cervical transverse processes to upper ribs                           |
|                          +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                          | - Pharyngeal and laryngeal dilator muscles:                                    |
|                          |   - Maintain airway patency                                                    |
|                          |   - Contraction timed with inspiration                                         |
|                          |   - CNIX (larynx) and X (larynx and pharynx)                                   |
|                          +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                          | - Dilators alae nasae:                                                         |
|                          |   - Maintain airway patency                                                    |
|                          |   - Contraction timed with inspiration                                         |
|                          |   - Important in neonates (obligate nose breathes, high total resistance)      |
+--------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Accessory muscles        | - Sternocleidomastoid:                                                         |
|                          |   - ↑CWE                                                                       |
|                          +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                          | - Levator scapulae:                                                            |
|                          |   - ↑CWE                                                                       |
|                          |   - Also: scapular elevation                                                   |
|                          +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                          | - Trapezius:                                                                   |
|                          |   - ↑CWE, scapular elevation                                                   |
|                          |   - Also: neck lateral flexion                                                 |
|                          +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                          | - Pectoralis major (when upper limb fixed):                                    |
|                          |   - ↑CWE, ↑APD                                                                 |
|                          |   - Also: shoulder flexion and adduction                                       |
|                          +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                          | - Costal slips of latissimus dorsi (when upper limb fixed):                    |
|                          |   - ↑CWE                                                                       |
|                          |   - Also: shoulder extension and adduction                                     |
|                          +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                          | - Serratus posterior superior                                                  |
|                          |   - ↑CWE                                                                       |
+--------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Expiration:

+---------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Aims    | - Overall: ↑ intra-pleural pressure hence ↓ transpulmonary pressure |
|         | - Opposite to inspiration                                           |
+---------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Passive | - Relaxation of inspiratory muscles                                 |
|         | - Elastic recoil due to surface tension and elastic lung tissue     |
|         | - Energy stored during inspiration                                  |
+---------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Active  | - Internal intercostals                                             |
|         |   - ↓ APD, ↓ TD by reverse Bucket handle activity                   |
|         |   - From rib below to rib above                                     |
|         |   - Back pocket direction                                           |
|         +---------------------------------------------------------------------+
|         | - Abdominals                                                        |
|         |   - ↓ APD, ↓ TD, ↓CWE                                               |
|         |   - Rectus, transversus, internal and external obliques             |
|         |   - Pull down chest wall                                            |
|         |   - ↑intra-abdo pressure, push up diaphragm                         |
|         +---------------------------------------------------------------------+
|         | - Latissimus dorsi                                                  |
|         |   - ↓ APD, ↓ TD, ↓ CWE                                              |
|         +---------------------------------------------------------------------+
|         | - Serratus posterior inferior                                       |
|         |   - ↓CWE                                                            |
|         +---------------------------------------------------------------------+
|         | Quadratus lumborum                                                  |
|         |                                                                     |
|         | - ↓CWE                                                              |
+---------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Non-ventilatory functions:

+------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Coughing                           | - Inspiration, glottic closure, expiratory muscle contraction, glottic opening           |
+------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Phonation                          | - Expiration with partial glottic closure                                                |
+------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Increased intra-abdominal pressure | - Expiratory muscle contraction with closed glottis                                      |
|                                    |   - Splint vertebral column during exertion                                              |
|                                    |   - Abdominal or pelvic evacuation (e.g. vomiting, micturition, defecation, parturition) |
+------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
